context: Checkpoint 2026-08-03. THE OPERATOR JOURNEY IS CLOSED: from the phone, farm-start started the declared rcdc5 operation and farm-start --status returned `succeeded` with the bounded operation-result.v1 (10 packages, 0 issues) — the first time the whole path ran through the surface an operator actually types, rather than through POST /operations directly. Getting there cost three field bugs, all now fixed and re-published: farm-start dropped the operation id to an indexOf(-1); the extraction that fixed it left two dangling references (farm-client had no lint at all, being the only plain-JS package, so `no-undef` now guards the artifact that ships to a phone); and the secret prompt's mask grew past the row, so on a narrow terminal each redraw left its own visibleTail behind — a sliding window that reconstructs the whole credential. The mask is now bounded by the row. farm-auth also dumped a stack trace on Ctrl+C: it was the only bin that asks anything and the only one with no cancellation handling; a conformance test now fails if a bin that asks does not handle it. Separately, the node-base spec is written and awaiting a decision.
